name: Check Spy Versions

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-spy-versions:
    name: Check Spy Versions
    runs-on: ubuntu-x64-small
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@f7ccc83f9ed1e5b9c81d8a67d7ad1a747e22a561
        with:
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Run spy version check script
        run: ./ci/check-spy-versions.sh
